result.description: Compact benchtop incubator designed for stable low-temperature sample conditioning in teaching labs and field stations. Features a quiet thermoelectric chamber, digital temperature control, internal circulation fan, and a corrosion-resistant anodized housing. Intended for biological storage, reagent warm-up, and controlled environmental testing rather than computing or consumer storage.
result.title: Aurelia Noxis 14 Core Sealed Laboratory Incubator
